title: Receipt evidence
rule: Each claim needs a readable itemized receipt identifying merchant, date, total and currency. Missing required evidence requires human review; a missing receipt number alone is not disqualifying.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §DOC-001
text: Receipt evidence. Each claim needs a readable itemized receipt identifying merchant, date, total and currency. Missing required evidence requires human review; a missing receipt number alone is not disqualifying. Exceptions: None

title: Submission deadline
rule: Submit within 30 calendar days after the receipt date, inclusive. Later submissions are likely ineligible when dates are established. A submission before the expense date or an unknown date requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §GEN-002
text: Submission deadline. Submit within 30 calendar days after the receipt date, inclusive. Later submissions are likely ineligible when dates are established. A submission before the expense date or an unknown date requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Duplicate claims
rule: A confirmed duplicate claim is likely ineligible. A clear historical duplicate check is required before likely eligible; an unknown check requires human review. Receipt ID alone does not prove duplication.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §GEN-003
text: Duplicate claims. A confirmed duplicate claim is likely ineligible. A clear historical duplicate check is required before likely eligible; an unknown check requires human review. Receipt ID alone does not prove duplication. Exceptions: None

title: Business purpose and approval
rule: Every claim requires a stated business purpose and documented manager approval before a likely-eligible pre-screen. Missing approval requires human review. All pre-screen results await a final Finance decision; no model can approve payment.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §GEN-004
text: Business purpose and approval. Every claim requires a stated business purpose and documented manager approval before a likely-eligible pre-screen. Missing approval requires human review. All pre-screen results await a final Finance decision; no model can approve payment. Exceptions: None

title: Meal limit
rule: Business meals are limited to SGD 50 per attendee per meal, inclusive of taxes and service charges. The supported attendee count must be known. A documented amount above the per-person limit is likely ineligible.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §MEAL-001
text: Meal limit. Business meals are limited to SGD 50 per attendee per meal, inclusive of taxes and service charges. The supported attendee count must be known. A documented amount above the per-person limit is likely ineligible. Exceptions: None

title: Alcohol
rule: Alcohol is not reimbursable. If alcohol is included in the claimed amount, that submitted claim is likely ineligible. If allocation is unclear, human review is required; a corrected claim excluding alcohol is assessed separately.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §MEAL-002
text: Alcohol. Alcohol is not reimbursable. If alcohol is included in the claimed amount, that submitted claim is likely ineligible. If allocation is unclear, human review is required; a corrected claim excluding alcohol is assessed separately. Exceptions: None

title: Client meals
rule: For client meals, attendee names, organizations and business purpose must be documented. Missing details require human review. For non-client meals this card adds no further requirement.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §MEAL-003
text: Client meals. For client meals, attendee names, organizations and business purpose must be documented. Missing details require human review. For non-client meals this card adds no further requirement. Exceptions: None

title: Public transport
rule: Actual public-transport business-trip fares are reimbursable when business purpose and route evidence are documented. Personal commuting is not reimbursable.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §TRANSPORT-001
text: Public transport. Actual public-transport business-trip fares are reimbursable when business purpose and route evidence are documented. Personal commuting is not reimbursable. Exceptions: None

title: Taxi and ride hail
rule: Business taxi or ride-hail fares are limited to SGD 80 per trip. Above that limit is likely ineligible except where TRANSPORT-003 applies. Route and business purpose must be supported.
exceptions: Late-night business trips are governed by TRANSPORT-003.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §TRANSPORT-002
text: Taxi and ride hail. Business taxi or ride-hail fares are limited to SGD 80 per trip. Above that limit is likely ineligible except where TRANSPORT-003 applies. Route and business purpose must be supported. Exceptions: Late-night business trips are governed by TRANSPORT-003.

title: Late-night travel
rule: For documented business travel between 22:00 and 06:00 local time, taxi or ride-hail fares up to SGD 120 per trip may be pre-screened eligible with documented manager approval and route/time evidence. Above SGD 120 is likely ineligible. Unknown time or approval requires human review.
exceptions: Replaces the SGD 80 taxi cap only when all night-travel conditions are evidenced.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §TRANSPORT-003
text: Late-night travel. For documented business travel between 22:00 and 06:00 local time, taxi or ride-hail fares up to SGD 120 per trip may be pre-screened eligible with documented manager approval and route/time evidence. Above SGD 120 is likely ineligible. Unknown time or approval requires human review. Exceptions: Replaces the SGD 80 taxi cap only when all night-travel conditions are evidenced.

title: Route evidence
rule: All transport claims require journey date, origin, destination and business purpose evidence. Unknown transport mode or missing route evidence requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §TRANSPORT-004
text: Route evidence. All transport claims require journey date, origin, destination and business purpose evidence. Unknown transport mode or missing route evidence requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Hotel limit
rule: Accommodation room charges including taxes are capped at SGD 250 per night. The number of nights and room-charge allocation must be supported. Amount above the cap is assessed under HOTEL-003; an unresolved allocation requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §HOTEL-001
text: Hotel limit. Accommodation room charges including taxes are capped at SGD 250 per night. The number of nights and room-charge allocation must be supported. Amount above the cap is assessed under HOTEL-003; an unresolved allocation requires human review. Exceptions: HOTEL-003 governs over-limit cases.

title: Personal hotel items
rule: Personal hotel items such as minibar, spa or leisure charges are excluded. A submitted claim including established personal charges is likely ineligible; an unclear split requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §HOTEL-002
text: Personal hotel items. Personal hotel items such as minibar, spa or leisure charges are excluded. A submitted claim including established personal charges is likely ineligible; an unclear split requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Over-limit accommodation
rule: Over-limit accommodation always requires Finance human review to verify an exception. Attach prior approval if it exists; if none exists, request a Finance exception review. An employee statement or manager confirmation is not by itself a final approval.
exceptions: No automatic eligibility for over-limit stays, even with prior approval.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §HOTEL-003
text: Over-limit accommodation. Over-limit accommodation always requires Finance human review to verify an exception. Attach prior approval if it exists; if none exists, request a Finance exception review. An employee statement or manager confirmation is not by itself a final approval. Exceptions: No automatic eligibility for over-limit stays, even with prior approval.

title: Flight class
rule: Business air travel is limited to economy class. A clearly identified higher class is likely ineligible; an unknown class requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §AIR-001
text: Flight class. Business air travel is limited to economy class. A clearly identified higher class is likely ineligible; an unknown class requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Travel preapproval
rule: Business flight claims require documented approval obtained before travel. Absent or unverified preapproval requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §AIR-002
text: Travel preapproval. Business flight claims require documented approval obtained before travel. Absent or unverified preapproval requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Foreign currency
rule: Non-SGD claims require a documented conversion rate and its supporting bank or payment record. Convert the relevant amount into SGD before comparing caps; do not use a live or guessed exchange rate. Missing conversion evidence requires human review.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §FX-001
text: Foreign currency. Non-SGD claims require a documented conversion rate and its supporting bank or payment record. Convert the relevant amount into SGD before comparing caps; do not use a live or guessed exchange rate. Missing conversion evidence requires human review. Exceptions: None

title: Lost receipt
rule: A lost-receipt declaration and alternative payment evidence may be submitted, but every lost-receipt claim requires human review. The declaration never makes a claim automatically eligible.
source: Northstar Consulting Teaching Expense Policy v1.0 §LOST-001
text: Lost receipt. A lost-receipt declaration and alternative payment evidence may be submitted, but every lost-receipt claim requires human review. The declaration never makes a claim automatically eligible. Exceptions: None
